correctness.rationale: Exact finite-state row Markov generator; nonnegative update iff all entries nonnegative; explicit walk-power formulas prove necessity/sufficiency for H3/H4 with positive rates. value.rationale: The sharp method-order positivity inversion is an informative nontrivial structural boundary: for all positive-rate pure-birth paths a fourth-order step can be almost 13% more restrictive or nearly 75% less restrictive than third order, and the first disadvantage arises at five states. A natural rate architecture attains the worst ratio. This is a positivity-constrained solver selection fact rather than generic polynomial root computation; it does not imply accuracy superiority.
